guideTitle: Best Air Fryer Toaster Ovens Under $100 (2026)
metaTitle: Best Air Fryer Toaster Ovens Under $100 (2026)
metaDescription: Four air fryer toaster ovens at or under $100, from a Hamilton Beach 4 slice to GOLUX 13 quart and 10 quart three-layer models, compared on size and controls.
expertTake: The GOLUX 13 quart combo is the pick at this cap because a 1500W system with six heating elements and four modes gives the most oven for the money. The Hamilton Beach 4 slice is the value choice for a small counter and a simple 30 minute timer. Anyone cooking for a family of four or more should skip this cap and look at a 6 slice or larger oven.
introParagraphs: An air fryer toaster oven is a small convection oven with a fan and a perforated basket. It blows hot air across food so the surface browns quickly with little oil, and it also toasts, bakes and broils like a traditional toaster oven.

Prices move, and the $100 cap used here reflects live listing prices when this guide was updated. At this cap the ovens are small, so the useful questions are interior size, how many heating elements fire together and whether the controls are simple knobs or a panel that can fail.

products.name: GOLUX 13 Quart 1500W Air Fryer Toaster Oven Combo with Basket and Tray

specList.label: Modes
specList.value: Four, including top heat with convection

products.description:
The GOLUX is a 13 quart oven that pairs a 1500W heating system with six heating elements and convection airflow. Four cooking modes, including top heat with convection, let you choose between a quick crisp and a gentle bake. A basket and a tray are included, so you can air fry wings on one and bake on the other.

Six elements matter because they spread heat across more of the cavity, which reduces the hot spots that a two-element toaster oven has. Set beside the Hamilton Beach 4 slice, it is larger and more powerful, but it also needs more counter space. Measured against the PHS, it has more power and a fuller accessory set, but a bigger footprint.

Preheat for a few minutes, and rotate the basket halfway through for even browning. Wipe the interior after each use and empty the crumb tray, since fat splatter bakes on and smokes at the next cook. Leave several inches of clearance on all sides, because the exterior gets very hot. Wings and breaded chicken do best in the basket on the middle rack with the fan mode, while pizza and casseroles belong on the tray with top heat and convection together. If your outlet is shared with a microwave or kettle, run the oven alone, since 1500W is a heavy load for a kitchen circuit.
products.bestFor: Small families who want a larger cavity and strong heat on a budget.

products.name: Hamilton Beach 4 Slice Air Fryer Toaster Oven Combo, 30 Minute Timer
products.description:
The Hamilton Beach 4 slice offers four functions, air fry, bake, broil and toast, with a 30 minute timer and a convection fan that circulates air around food. It is the cheapest oven here on the price tier, and the compact body fits a small counter. The brand is easy to find in stores, and replacement parts are easy to order.

Next to the GOLUX, it has less capacity and no stated wattage or element count, so it cooks smaller batches and may take longer. Against the 10 quart three-layer oven, it is simpler, with fewer features to fail. A four-slice oven handles a personal pizza, a few chicken thighs or a tray of wings in two batches.

The 30 minute timer is a limit: long bakes need you to reset it. Dump the crumb tray often and wipe the walls to prevent smoke. Use the basket for air frying only, and place a baking sheet underneath to catch grease. Two slices of toast take longer than they do in a dedicated toaster, and the first batch toasts lighter than the second because the elements and walls are still warming up. If you intend to roast anything larger than a few chicken thighs, check the interior height first, because the top element sits close to the rack.
products.bestFor: Singles, couples and small kitchens that want a simple oven.
pros: Lowest price tier in the lineup

products.name: PHS 12 Quart Toaster Oven Air Fryer Combo with Mechanical Knobs
products.description:
The PHS is a compact metal oven with mechanical knobs, a 12 quart cavity and an exterior of 13 by 13 by 12.6 inches. The inner length is 10.7 inches, enough for personal pizzas, toast slices and chicken breasts. Mechanical knobs mean no electronic panel to fail, which is a real durability advantage in a hot kitchen.

The small footprint is the point: it fits an apartment or dorm counter that cannot take a bigger oven. Next to the GOLUX, it is smaller and has less stated power, but it uses simpler controls. Set beside the Hamilton Beach, it has a larger stated cavity and a full metal body.

Knobs set temperature, function and timer, so there is no digital readout. Use an oven thermometer to check accuracy, since knob dials drift. Clean the crumb tray weekly and keep the vents clear. Because the body is metal, the exterior gets hot enough to burn a forearm, so keep the oven away from the counter edge and out of reach of children. Slide the rack to the position the manual recommends for air frying, which usually sits close to the fan side and gives the strongest airflow across the food.
products.bestFor: Apartments and dorms that want the smallest footprint with simple knobs.

products.name: 10 Quart Air Fryer Toaster Oven with Three-Layer Cooking and Visible Window
products.description:
This 10 quart oven offers three cooking layers, a visible window and five cooking modes. It has independent top and bottom heating, so you can heat one side more than the other and avoid flipping food. The window lets you watch browning without opening the door and losing heat.

Independent heating is the useful feature, since it lets you brown the top of a casserole while keeping the bottom gentle. Measured against the GOLUX, it is smaller with fewer stated specifications. Against the PHS, it adds the window and the heating control but not the metal body or mechanical knobs.

Check the window for grease buildup, and wipe it with a damp cloth when cool. Use the middle layer for even cooking and the top layer for browning. Keep the door closed during cooking to hold heat. A window is a safety aid as well as a convenience, since you can spot flare-ups in fatty food before smoke fills the kitchen. With three layers, check that the rack you use clears the top element by at least an inch, because food touching an element will burn and smoke.
products.bestFor: Cooks who want to watch food and control top and bottom heat.

buyingCriteria.explanation: Quart ratings overstate usable space. The PHS has a 10.7 inch inner length, enough for a personal pizza, while the GOLUX offers 13 quarts. Measure the pans you own before buying, and check that a 9 inch pizza or an 8 inch square pan fits flat. A bigger oven needs more clearance, so measure the counter and the cabinet above. Door swing counts too, since a drop-down door needs room in front of the unit and a fully open door can hit a backsplash. Lay the pans you use most on the counter and compare them with the interior length listed, because a pan that fits by a fraction of an inch will not clear the heating elements.

More elements and higher wattage preheat faster and spread heat better. The GOLUX lists 1500W and six elements, which is strong for this cap. Higher wattage can trip a shared circuit when other appliances run, so do not plug it into the same outlet as a kettle. Wattage is not listed for several of these ovens, so compare size and element count. A bigger cavity needs more power to heat the same air, which is why a 13 quart oven and a 10 quart oven with the same listed wattage will behave differently on a cold start. Give any oven five minutes to preheat before judging its browning, and use the middle rack for the most even results.

Air frying in a toaster oven is convection plus a perforated basket. Results are good for wings and fries but batches are small, so do not expect it to replace a basket air fryer for a family. Shake or turn food halfway through. Fat drips onto the tray below, so use a drip pan. Foods that crisp well include frozen fries, wings, breaded cutlets and roasted vegetables, while wet batters run off the basket and make a mess. Spread food in a single layer with gaps for airflow, since crowding is the most common reason air-fried food comes out soft.

Mechanical knobs, as on the PHS, last longer in hot kitchens than touch panels and lack a screen to fail. The cost is accuracy, since knob dials can be 25 to 50 degrees Fahrenheit off. An oven thermometer solves that for a few dollars. Timers on budget models stop at 30 or 60 minutes. A cheap oven thermometer that hangs from the rack will tell you in one cook how far the dial is off, and you can then set the knob a notch up or down to compensate. Keep a note of the correction on the oven so the next cook starts right.

Crumbs and grease build up on the walls and the tray, and burnt crumbs smoke and can ignite. Empty the crumb tray weekly and wipe the interior after greasy cooks. Enamel interiors wipe clean, and textured ones do not. Keep foil off the heating elements and tray. A baking sheet lined with parchment cut to size makes cleanup easy, but trim it so it never hangs near the fan or the elements. For stuck-on grease, a paste of baking soda and water on the cool interior loosens it without scratching the enamel.

Exterior surfaces get very hot, so leave several inches of clearance and do not tuck the oven under a cabinet. Never leave an oven unattended while broiling, since fatty foods spit and ignite. Use oven mitts on the door handle and the tray. A window helps you check without opening the door. Place the oven on a heat-resistant surface rather than a delicate counter, and keep paper towels, plastic bags and curtains well away. A stable, level surface also matters, since a hot tray that slides can spill grease onto the floor.

howWeEvaluated.title: Size and fit
howWeEvaluated.description: We compared quart ratings, inner lengths and footprints, from the PHS's 10.7 inch cavity to the GOLUX's 13 quarts. Real pan fit counted more than the quart number.

howWeEvaluated.title: Heating design
howWeEvaluated.description: Stated wattage, element count and heating control were weighed. The GOLUX's six elements and 1500W and the 10 quart oven's independent heating stood out.

howWeEvaluated.title: Controls
howWeEvaluated.description: Mechanical knobs and timer limits were compared. The PHS's knobs scored for durability, and the Hamilton Beach's 30 minute timer scored for simplicity.

howWeEvaluated.title: Cleaning and safety
howWeEvaluated.description: Crumb trays, window access and exterior heat were considered. Every oven needs clearance and attention while broiling.

howWeEvaluated.title: Fit at the cap
howWeEvaluated.description: Every item is at or under the cap on its live listing. We favored heat and size over a long list of presets.

cards.label: Mechanical knobs (PHS)
cards.text: Simple and durable, with no panel to fail. Temperatures are approximate, so use a thermometer.

cards.label: Preset modes (GOLUX, 10 quart)
cards.text: Four or five modes and clearer settings. A panel is another failure point in a hot kitchen.

howToChoose.note: Choose knobs for durability and modes for convenience.

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: A footprint under 14 inches wide, cool-touch handles and a door that does not block the counter. Check the cabinet clearance above.

cards.label: In this comparison
cards.text: The PHS is the smallest at 13 inches square, and the Hamilton Beach is the simplest. The GOLUX needs the most room.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: You want a 6 slice interior, a stainless body or a digital panel with presets. Higher tiers also hold a full 12 inch pizza.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: You air fry a few items a week, in which case a 4 slice oven is plenty.

maintenance.why: Burnt crumbs smoke and can ignite, and a full tray also blocks airflow under the bottom element. Slide it out, tip it into the bin and wipe it dry before the next use.
Baked-on grease smokes and gives the next batch a stale flavor. A damp cloth works when the oven is cool, and a drop of dish soap handles stubborn spots on enamel.

Grease builds up in the mesh and affects flavor, so soak the basket and tray in warm soapy water after every air fry and dry them before reinserting. Avoid steel wool, which strips any nonstick finish.
Dial temperatures drift by 25 to 50 degrees Fahrenheit on budget ovens, which changes cook times. A hanging oven thermometer shows the real heat, and you can adjust the knob accordingly.
Blocked vents trap heat and strain the fan motor. Wipe dust away with a dry cloth and keep the sides and rear of the oven clear of the wall.

faq.q: Is an air fryer toaster oven better than a basket air fryer?
faq.a: It is more versatile because it toasts and bakes too, but batches are smaller. A basket air fryer crisps faster and holds more, and it takes less counter space if you never bake or toast. If you already own a toaster, a basket model may be the better single purchase.
It buys 10 to 13 quart combo ovens with convection and a basket. The cap reflects listing prices when this guide was updated.

faq.q: How long do these ovens last?
faq.a: Three to five years of regular use. Timers, knobs and heating elements are the wear points, and a unit that is wiped down regularly outlasts one that is allowed to cake with grease, since baked-on residue overheats the element beneath it.
Only in small pieces and never touching the elements. Do not cover the crumb tray, because trapped heat and blocked airflow cause smoke and can damage the oven.

faq.q: Why does my food brown unevenly?
faq.a: Hot spots are common in budget ovens. Rotate the tray and turn food halfway through, and avoid crowding the basket. A rack placed too close to the top element also scorches the surface before the center cooks, so move it down a level.

faq.q: Can I use it for a frozen pizza?
faq.a: A personal frozen pizza fits in most of these. A 12 inch pizza needs a larger oven.
